title: Foreign Trade Policy, EOUs and trade facilitation
quote: FTP 2023: from incentives to remission; $2 trillion exports by 2030

boxes.title: FTP 2023 features
items: ==Target **$2 trillion** exports by **2030**== (⚠ Goyal Jul 2026: **$1 trillion** goal)
**Districts as Export Hubs**; new **Towns of Export Excellence**
Trade settlement in **INR**; merchanting trade promoted
EPCG green list: **BEVs**, green hydrogen, vertical farming

boxes.title: Export incentive schemes
head: Scheme
What it does
rows: Replaced **MEIS**; refunds unrebated taxes; run by **CBIC**
Refund of duty on inputs used in exports

boxes.title: New missions
items: ==**Export Promotion Mission**: **₹25,060 crore**==, FY 2025-26 to 2030-31, by DGFT
Merges Interest Equalisation + Market Access Initiative; for **MSMEs**
Niryat Disha tools: **TRACE, FLOW, LIFT, INSIGHT**
**RELIEF 2026**: **₹497 crore** via **ECGC**; West Asia war-risk; Egypt, Jordan added
Budget 2026-27: AA export period **6 months → 1 year** (leather, footwear)

boxes.title: SEZ vs EOU / EHTP / STP
head: Unit
Nature
rows: Goods; export all output, located anywhere

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Import substitution = **reducing import dependency** (PYQ); about four decades
Customs union: common external tariff → common market (+ factors) → economic union (+ policies)
EPCG = capital goods; AA = inputs; ==RoDTEP replaced MEIS==
